lines: d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Hattie Foley is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d40: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d40: 🕯️ Hattie Foley is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d40: What Hattie kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d40: "Hattie's gone." Wilhelm looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Hattie." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d40: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Daniela blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Soft Step (Level 1). Move through woods like weather. Less noise, fewer surprises.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Beekeeping (Level 1). Smoke calms bees. Work slow, work covered, never swat.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
d40: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
d40: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Hattie Foley, 40 days. The mantle passes to Daniela Rojas.
d40: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Daniela Rojas, 43 — a Beekeeper. Their hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Lucky Rock.
d40: The village's quarrel was with Hattie — and Hattie is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d40: At the grave, Wilhelm, Quinn, Lucas and 2 more speak for Daniela — "Hattie trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d40: The fire knew Daniela before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
